Almost 1000 free story and book, select book and start reading, what if you encounter a word you don't know? Just touch the word! Its meaning will be popped-up immediately, then read on continuously.

* You can select the language you want to see the translation.
* You can mark books as read & unread.
* You can mark books as favorited & unfavorited.
